card.name: Spots before a dose or comparison
card.fires_on: Small words or name pieces right before a dose, arm or comparison, such as 'receive', 'with or without', 'every', or the end of a brand name before 'and placebo'.

modes.label: Words before a dose
modes.description: A linking word or comma just before a dose amount or schedule.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Partway through a drug brand name in a comparison with placebo.
modes.example: patients treated with<< VR>>AYLAR and placebo

modes.label: Contrast words
modes.description: Words like 'without' or 'that' that open a comparison or claim of difference.
modes.example: with or<< without>> the concomitant use of alcohol

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning 'varying' or 'different', so it seems to steer away from saying results differ.
card.plain: It fires at small words before a dose or comparison, and holds back words like 'different' or 'varies'.
